subject: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@clearwave.com>, Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan

Hi Sara / Mark — great to meet this morning. Thanks again for walking through ClearWave's timeline; below is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) slice focused on the security review / SOC 2 package so we can lock milestones and owners. Please confirm the dates that work for you or flag any internal compliance windows we should be aware of.

MAP: SOC 2 intake & evidence
1) Redwood: provide 1-page SOC 2 summary and architecture notes — Owner: Lauren Bishop — Due: 2027-06-10
2) ClearWave: return completed SOC 2 questionnaire (attached template or your answers) — Owner: Sara Jenkins / compliance@clearwave.com — Due: 2027-06-12
3) Evidence index + delivery (logs, config snapshots, encryption attestations) — Owner: ClearWave (deliver) / Rishi (acceptance) — Target delivery: 2027-06-19 (dependency: logs export from platform-engineering)
4) Security review call (walkthrough of answers + follow-ups) — Owner: joint — Proposed meeting: 2027-06-15 10:00 PT (meet link below)
5) Final redlines / acceptance to proceed with pilot — Target close date: 2027-06-25

Dependencies & notes:
- Engineering export: ClearWave indicated they may need structured log exports; if ClearWave needs assistance to validate formats, Redwood's infra team can provide an example CSV/generic schema.
- If any evidence cannot be shared (air-gapped items), indicate in the evidence index and we'll propose alternative controls or an in-person review.

Attachments: I attached a short Redwood SOC 2 summary and our baseline questionnaire (soc2-questionnaire.pdf). I'll also drop an evidence-index-template.xlsx to the drive link below for you to populate.

Next step: please reply with the completed questionnaire or a tentative delivery date for the evidence index. If 6/19 is too late, tell us the earliest compliance cutoff you have and we'll adjust.

Thanks — look forward to locking this down.

— Lauren Bishop
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@clearwave.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@clearwave.com>, compliance@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-06-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. The proposed milestones look reasonable; one ask: our compliance team has an internal gate on 6/20, so if at all possible we'd like evidence in by 6/17 to allow internal review. We can move the evidence index due to 2027-06-17 on our side.

I've attached our partially completed questionnaire (clearwave-soc2-answers.pdf) — we filled the admin/security sections and left technical evidence pointers for your team to review.

Questions from our side:
- Can Redwood provide an example logs export schema so we can confirm matching formats?
- Are there any items in the evidence index that you consider mandatory for pilot access (vs. "nice-to-have")?

I'll accept the 6/15 security review call proposal; propose 10:00 PT. Sending a calendar hold now.

Attachments: clearwave-soc2-answers.pdf

Thanks,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Compliance Operations
ClearWave Financial
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@clearwave.com>, Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan

Thanks Lauren / Sara — quick operational notes from the security team:
- We'll deliver a short "logs export schema" example by 2027-06-07 (I will upload an example CSV and a minimal README to the Drive link). That should be enough for ClearWave to confirm format.
- On evidence prioritization: mandatory for pilot = encryption-at-rest proof (KMS timestamps), access control list export for service accounts, retention policy excerpt, and a sample audit log slice. Everything else can be marked "optional / on request" in the index.
- Engineering dependency: platform-engineering needs a ticket to produce a 30-day log slice in the requested format; I will open that ticket today and aim to have the artifact ready by 2027-06-14 so ClearWave can supply the evidence file to us by 6/17.

I'll attach an evidence-index-template.xlsx (minimal columns: evidence_id, owner, file_name, description, sensitivity, delivery_date). Lauren — can you confirm if legal needs to review any of the evidence before we accept?

- Rishi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@clearwave.com>, Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan

Perfect — thank you both. Updated commitments based on the thread:
- Redwood to upload SOC2 summary + logs schema by 2027-06-07 (Lauren / Rishi) — Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ExampleDriveLink
- ClearWave to return filled questionnaire + evidence index by 2027-06-17 (Sara / compliance@clearwave.com)
- Joint security review call: 2027-06-15 10:00 PT — Meet: https://meet.google.com/lookup/clearwave-security-review
- Target MAP close for pilot provisioning: 2027-06-25

I've created a HubSpot ticket for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/RWI-2027-CW-001 — I will attach the evidence-index once Rishi confirms the final template.

If all good, I'll mark this MAP milestone as "locked" and send calendar invites for the 6/15 review.

— Lauren
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence milestone plan

Ack — I'll reserve 6/15 at 10:00 PT for the review and keep an eye on the HubSpot ticket. If ClearWave would like an adapter script for the logs export, we can provide a small helper prior to 6/14.

— Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
